name: popover
title: Popover
description: Floating panels anchored to their trigger with the native popover attribute and CSS anchor positioning. Includes a hover behavior for tooltips and hover cards.

classes.name: popover
classes.description: The floating panel. Opens below the trigger and flips above when there is no room.

classes.name: popover--block-end-start
classes.description: Below, aligned to the trigger's start edge.

classes.name: popover--block-end-end
classes.description: Below, aligned to the trigger's end edge.

classes.name: popover--block-start-start
classes.description: Above, aligned to the start edge.

classes.name: popover--block-start-end
classes.description: Above, aligned to the end edge.

classes.name: popover--unanchored
classes.description: No anchoring; position it yourself (used by the context menu).

variables.name: --popover-margin-block
variables.description: Gap between the trigger and the panel.

attributes.name: popover
attributes.description: Native attribute. popover (auto) closes on outside click and Escape; popover="manual" only closes from code; popover="hint" is for tooltips.

attributes.name: popovertarget
attributes.description: Native attribute: toggles the popover with this id and anchors it to the button.

attributes.name: data-interest
attributes.description: Shows a popover while the pointer is over this element.

attributes.name: data-interest-for
attributes.description: Id of the popover to show.

notes: Hover popovers are positioned with showPopover({ source }), so they anchor to the hovered element.
